inv_counts_sum.basis: per corpus: Σ_status distinct pmids == distinct pmids; registry vs expected (MANIFEST papers)

inv_generation_provenance.basis: extracted/referenced rows: pipeline_generation non-null and prompt_ref != unpinned; one (generation, prompt_sha256) per package

inv_n_findings_by_status.basis: extracted => n_findings >= 1; every other status => n_findings == 0

inv_no_reextraction_of_sibling_paper.basis: rows with extraction_status=extracted grouped by pmid: distinct corpus <= 1, minus documented exceptions

inv_one_extraction_per_pmid_per_generati.basis: rows with extraction_status=extracted, grouped by (pmid, pipeline_generation): distinct corpus <= 1, minus rows listed in the documented exceptions table

inv_partition_within_corpus.basis: extracted rows grouped by (corpus, pmid): distinct package <= 1

inv_reference_only_consistent.basis: reference_only is true exactly on rows with extraction_status=referenced

inv_referenced_exists_in_sibling.basis: referenced rows: each shared_with sibling has an extracted row for the pmid

inv_shared_with_consistent.basis: shared_with == {corpora with an extracted row for the pmid} minus own corpus, on every row

inv_status_enum.basis: extraction_status in ('extracted', 'dispatched_no_yield', 'referenced', 'planned', 'excluded_screen', 'not_extractable'); universe_status null or in ('shared', 'new')

inv_universe_status_consistent.basis: shared & not sibling_dispatched_no_yield <=> referenced; shared & sibling_dispatched_no_yield => not referenced; new => never referenced

notes: v1 adds statuses excluded_screen/not_extractable and the sibling_dispatched_no_yield rule for shared papers re-extracted here (223 POTS no-yield papers -> 88 in roster v3 -> 49 extracted).
88 fresh-draw papers (27 rostered, 61 screen-excluded) were absent from the Tier-5 universe parquet and are added with universe_status=new.
tier stored as string ('1' / POTS tier labels).
